label: Street Candid
description: Street photography over a dedicated stranger cast: an ordinary passerby caught in a decisive moment, city geometry and weather doing the mood work, reportage optics locked to the street kit.
prefix: A candid street photograph, the decisive moment — {passerby}, caught {moment}, unaware of the frame closing around them.
suffix: Street Rendering: (unposed truth, strangers layered through the depth of the frame, geometry aligning for one held instant:1.2), available light only, honest grain, motion allowed to blur at the frame edges, the city indifferent around its subject.
negative: posed studio look, studio lighting, watermark, text, child, underage
